mapper.select: SELECT version,planning_days,schedule_day,schedule_time,marketing_max,hotspot_ratio, updated_by,CAST(updated_at AS CHAR) AS updated_at FROM godp_business_planning_config WHERE del_flag='N' AND config_key='operations'

SELECT version,planning_days,schedule_day,schedule_time,marketing_max,hotspot_ratio, action,source_version,created_by,CAST(created_at AS CHAR) AS created_at FROM godp_business_planning_config_version WHERE del_flag='N' AND config_key='operations' AND version=#{version}
SELECT * FROM godp_business_planning_config WHERE del_flag='N' AND config_key='operations' FOR UPDATE

SELECT version,planning_days,schedule_day,schedule_time,marketing_max,hotspot_ratio, action,source_version,created_by,CAST(created_at AS CHAR) AS created_at FROM godp_business_planning_config_version WHERE del_flag='N' AND config_key='operations' ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE godp_business_planning_config SET version=version+1,planning_days=#{days}, schedule_day=#{config.schedule_day},schedule_time=#{config.schedule_time}, marketing_max=#{config.marketing_max},hotspot_ratio=#{config.hotspot_ratio}, updated_by=#{actor},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE del_flag='N' AND config_key='operations' AND version=#{expected}
